summary: Sandbach United are just one week away from kicking off their 2026/27 campaign after a mixed preseason, with a recent tight loss to St Helens showing both sides played well despite the result. The squad has been strengthened with several fantastic new signings and a returning player, while the club has also unveiled three brand new kits for the season ahead. With promotion the goal this year, the Ramblers are looking for sponsorship partners to support their quest.
